ownership.PlayerView: attach/pre-draw observations and existing overlay container; ordinary primary view retained
ownership.surface: one HandlerThread per SurfaceTexture; releases texture in thread finalizer
ownership.native_fence: closed render gate rejects queued work and waits for in-flight work before native session cleanup
ownership.context_loss: discard frame/GL/context owners, next frame recreates with forceUpdate
ownership.render_state: application-thread Player API access cached in session

limits: recording backend is not actual GLES display
no full Android Gradle build or APK
